about:
Midland Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1945 in New Berlin, Wisconsin, and has operated as a domestic manufacturer of plastic products for nearly eight decades. The company began as a plastics fabricator and has since expanded into a full-service distributor and custom manufacturer of high-performance plastics.

Today, Midland Plastics maintains a large inventory of plastic sheet, rod, and tube, and provides custom manufacturing services including CNC machining, thermoforming, vacuum forming, pressure forming, custom extrusions, and precision fabrication. The facility offers production cutting and forming capabilities for both prototype and production volumes, though specific headcount and facility size are not disclosed.

The company serves a range of industries including packaging, transportation (truck liners), medical devices, industrial equipment, construction (windows, skylights), signage and displays, and safety equipment (machine guards, containment panels). Customers include OEMs and fabricators requiring materials such as acrylic, polycarbonate, and polyethylene for applications ranging from display cases to medical components.

Midland Plastics emphasizes its long-standing U.S. manufacturing heritage, in-house material expertise, and the ability to guide customers to the optimal plastic for their specifications. The firm positions itself as a single source for both stock materials and custom-formed parts.
